deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout -> prod · release/v2.4.1 · commit abcdef1234 
env: production · order: US -> EU -> APAC · canary plan: 10% then 30% then 100% · change_window: 03:00-06:00 UTC :rocket:

alice: watching US canary, running smoke checks now :eyes:

deploy-bot: US canary progression: 10% -> 30% -> 100% ✅ · latency: within SLO · error delta: +0.02% (ok)

ben: starting EU canary at 10% now

ben: at 30% seeing intermittent tokenization timeouts on a subset of replicas (95p +120ms) :thinking_face:

marta: noted, can you paste an example trace?

ben: attaching snippet from trace service: ```trace_id: r1234 tokenization.delayed 127ms node: i-02a```

oncall-sre: replied, grabbing node logs and checking kernel messages

deploy-bot: EU canary paused at 30% due to elevated tokenization timeouts · automatic hold triggered by rollout-policies

marta: recommendation: pin EU to last stable release (release/v2.4.0) until root cause is found. APAC should not proceed while EU is unstable.

alice: +1 to pin EU, continue US prod as-is

deploy-bot: Action: pin EU -> release/v2.4.0 (commit 9f8e7d6) per request. APAC canary moved to HOLD (dependent region). :pause_button:

oncall-sre: quick runbook check: looking for memory / OOM / kernel logs. CMD I ran: ```journalctl -u inference -n 200 | grep tokeniz``` -> no OOM, saw spikes in userland threads

ben: adding note to release tracker about tokenization regressions in v2.4.1. Preparing a small rollback patch if needed.

deploy-bot: EU rollback initiated -> target commit 9f8e7d6 (release/v2.4.0) by automated fallback. ETA ~6m. Will post completion status.

marta: logging this for post-deploy retro, please add the canary metrics dashboard link in the release notes: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary-v2.4.1

deploy-bot: EU rollback COMPLETE · services healthy · latency back to baseline · error rate normalized ✅

deploy-bot: APAC canary resumed (was held) · starting at 10%

alice: APAC 10% -> 30% -> 100% — all green, no tokenization regressions seen in APAC nodes. Good to close the window. :tada:

ben: follow-up actions: schedule patch release for tokenization fix (target v2.4.2), add pin to changelog, and run extended canary once patch lands

marta: I'll draft a short postmortem and link to logs + timeline in #postmortems later today

deploy-bot: Summary: US full -> passed, EU pinned/rolled back to v2.4.0, APAC resumed and passed. Change window closed.

alice: thanks everyone. nice coordination. :thumbsup:
